manifest.name: dsh-suno-mcp
manifest.description: Connect DeepSeek Harness to the official Suno MCP to check credits and browse your music library.

readme.text:
Check remaining Suno credits and browse your music library in DeepSeek Harness. The Suno bundle uses [Suno's official MCP service](https://help.suno.com/en/articles/14551425) with your own account. Verified on official DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 on Windows.

**Package:** `dsh-suno-mcp` · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

1. In DSH Desktop, use Plugins → Discover and search for `dsh-suno-mcp` in the [shared community index](https://github.com/realguan/dsh-plugin-market), once the listing appears. For direct installation, use the v0.1.0 GitHub Release package with the Desktop-installed CLI while Desktop is closed:

```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add .\dsh-suno-mcp-0.1.0.tgz
   ```

2. Run the local helper with Node.js 22 or later. Review the requested read permissions and connect your Suno account in the official authorization page.

```powershell
   $dshRoot = if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $env:DSH_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh' }
   node (Join-Path $dshRoot 'profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-suno-mcp/src/auth.js')
   ```

3. Reopen Desktop and ask “Check my remaining Suno credits” or “List my three newest Suno songs.”

The bundle exposes account and library reads. OAuth uses a loopback callback with state and PKCE. The Windows helper stores the session under the active `DSH_HOME` with user-scoped DPAPI. To disconnect, close Desktop and remove the OAuth file under `DSH_HOME/dsh-suno-mcp`. Revoke access from your Suno account if needed.

Enable Custom plugin indexes, then open Plugins → Discover and add this community index:

```text
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/realguan/dsh-plugin-market@dist/dsh-index.json
```

Search for `dsh-suno-mcp` or `Suno` after the entry is listed. If the plugin solves a problem for you, a GitHub star helps others find the project.

在 DeepSeek Harness 里查 Suno 剩余点数、浏览和搜索曲库。插件连接 [Suno 官方 MCP](https://help.suno.com/en/articles/14551425)，每个人使用自己的 Suno 账号。已在 Windows 上的官方 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 验证。

包名为 `dsh-suno-mcp`。 [English](README.md)

1. 收录后，在 **插件 → 发现** 中选中[社区索引](https://github.com/realguan/dsh-plugin-market)，搜索 `dsh-suno-mcp`。也可以从 GitHub Release 下载 v0.1.0 安装包。关闭 Desktop 后，用 Desktop 自带的 DSH CLI 安装：

```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add .\dsh-suno-mcp-0.1.0.tgz
   ```

2. 使用 Node.js 22 或更新版本运行本地授权助手。在 Suno 官方页面查看只读权限并连接自己的账号：

```powershell
   $dshRoot = if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $env:DSH_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh' }
   node (Join-Path $dshRoot 'profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-suno-mcp/src/auth.js')
   ```

3. 重新打开 Desktop。可以问「查一下我还剩多少 Suno 点数」或「列出我最新的三首 Suno 歌曲」。

插件提供账号和曲库的只读工具。OAuth 通过本机回调完成，使用 state 和 PKCE 验证。Windows 在当前 `DSH_HOME` 下用当前用户的 DPAPI 加密保存授权。要断开连接，先关闭 Desktop，再移除 `DSH_HOME/dsh-suno-mcp` 下的 OAuth 文件。需要时可从 Suno 账号撤销授权。

启用自定义插件索引，然后在 **插件 → 发现** 添加这个社区索引：

```text
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/realguan/dsh-plugin-market@dist/dsh-index.json
```

收录后，搜索 `dsh-suno-mcp` 或 `Suno`。如果插件帮到了你，欢迎给仓库点个 Star，让其他 DSH 用户更容易找到它。
